title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: which declaration is judged for lateness and its signing date
content:
## Rule
For the late declaration fee under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the declaration judged is the acceptance's declaration submission whose type is initial and whose outcome is signed — the latest such submission when more than one exists. An initial declaration awaiting signature, returned for correction or withdrawn is never judged, and an acceptance without a signed initial declaration owes no late fee. Amendment declarations are held to the amendment deadline instead and never carry a late declaration fee. The date on which the shipper signed the judged declaration is the date its signed submission was registered in the declaration file, which is the only date the declaration file records for a signature.

## Selecting the declaration
| Declaration on the acceptance's file | Judged for lateness |
|---|---|
| initial, outcome signed (the only one) | yes |
| several initial declarations with outcome signed | only the latest of them |
| initial awaiting signature, returned for correction or withdrawn | never |
| amendment, any outcome | never |
| no signed initial declaration on file | nothing is judged; no late fee is owed |

## Worked case (hypothetical declaration file)
An acceptance's file shows an initial declaration returned for correction, registered on 2 May; an initial declaration signed, registered on 5 May; and an amendment signed, registered on 9 May.
- The returned declaration is never judged, and the amendment never carries a late declaration fee.
- The judged declaration is the signed initial declaration registered on 5 May, and its signing date is 5 May.
Had a further signed initial declaration been registered on 8 May, the latest one — 8 May — would be judged instead.

## Points of judgement
- *The shipper states it signed a day earlier than the file shows — which date is used?* The date on which the signed submission was registered; it is the only signature date the declaration file records.
